verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an email client and service like Outlook, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The only privacy-adjacent item concerns ads and advertising preferences on free accounts, which is a different control from telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
